evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Reinforcement learning (RL) trains video agents to locate sparse evidence for long-video question answering through structured memory retrieval and temporal re-observation.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Across episodes, VideoGym adapts VideoAgent's training distribution online: it casts per-period sample selection as an adversarial bandit over (modality, mode) arms and applies the EXP3 update to shift sampling toward arms with low answer accuracy.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: In our source pool, text-heavy questions account for 58% of samples, compared with 15% graph-heavy, 17% visual-heavy, and 10% time-range questions.

evidence.label: 给出任务规模或覆盖范围
evidence.excerpt: Across five long-video benchmarks, VideoGym lifts RL accuracy from 60.4% to 64.8% on average and by up to 10.5 pp on underrepresented graph-heavy questions with 3.3x sample efficiency.
